dishes.make_ahead: Make the filling up to 2 days ahead; assemble and bake on the night

steps.text: Soften the onion and garlic in the oil.
Brown the lamb mince.
Stir in the flour, paste, stock and rosemary and simmer until thick, then cool.
Cut the pastry into rounds, line the muffin tin, fill and add the puff lids. Brush with egg.
Bake at 200C until deep golden.
Soften the onion, garlic and carrot in the oil.
Stir in the lentils, flour, paste, stock and rosemary and simmer until thick, then cool.
Cut the pastry into rounds, line the muffin tin, fill and add the puff lids. Brush with egg.
Bake at 200C until deep golden.

veg.make_ahead: Make the filling up to 2 days ahead; assemble and bake on the night

dishes.make_ahead: Crumb the chicken up to 4 hours ahead and keep it chilled

steps.text: Slice and flatten the chicken into 8 thin steaks.
Crumb through the flour, egg and breadcrumbs.
Shallow fry, 3 minutes a side, in two batches.
Top with the napoli sauce, ham and cheese and grill until bubbling.
Fill the rolls.
Slice the eggplant into 8 rounds and salt for 10 minutes, then pat dry.
Crumb through the flour, egg and breadcrumbs.
Shallow fry, 3 minutes a side, in two batches.
Top with the napoli sauce and cheese and grill until bubbling.
Fill the rolls.

veg.make_ahead: Crumb the eggplant up to 4 hours ahead and keep it chilled

dishes.make_ahead: Rub the kangaroo with the pepperberry, garlic and oil up to 1 day ahead in the fridge; roast the wedges and sear on the night

steps.text: Cut the sweet potato into wedges, toss in oil and roast at 200C.
Rub the kangaroo with the pepperberry, crushed garlic and oil.
Roast the wedges until golden.
Sear the fillet hard in a hot pan to keep it rare.
Rest the fillet, then slice. Warm the plum sauce and serve alongside.

veg.n: Pepperberry roast eggplant with sweet potato
veg.make_ahead: Score and rub the eggplant up to 1 day ahead, covered in the fridge; roast and crumble the feta on the night

steps.text: Cut the sweet potato into wedges, toss in half the oil and roast at 200C.
Halve the eggplants lengthways, score the flesh deeply and rub with the pepperberry, crushed garlic, salt and remaining oil.
Roast the eggplant cut side up alongside the wedges until soft and golden.
Warm the plum sauce.
Crumble the feta over the eggplant and serve with the wedges and plum sauce.

dishes.n: Kings Canyon wattleseed and macadamia slice
dishes.make_ahead: Make up to 3 days ahead; keeps in the fridge

steps.text: Rub the cold butter into the flour and sugar and press into a lined tin.
Bake at 170C until pale gold.
Cook the condensed milk, butter, sugar and wattleseed until thick, then fold in the macadamias.
Spread the caramel over the base and cool.
Pour over the melted chocolate and chill, then cut into squares.

dishes.make_ahead: Purée up to 1 day, top with sparkling just before serving

steps.text: Blend most of the raspberries with the peach and sugar syrup until smooth, then strain.
Spoon the purée into four chilled flutes.
Top slowly with cold sparkling rosé, stir once gently and drop in a raspberry. Use sparkling grape juice for an alcohol-free version.
